name: lifterly
description: Plan, build, log and review strength-training sessions with your Lifterly account: the same plan, history and exercise catalogue as the Lifterly app.

interface.longDescription:
Lifterly brings your strength training into the conversation. Plan your week around what is already scheduled, get a session built from your goal, equipment, level and recent results, log a workout you did without the app, swap an exercise you cannot do, and review your consistency, records and plateaus.

Everything uses your Lifterly account: sessions you add appear in the Lifterly app's plan, and workouts you log join your history. Cards show proposed sessions, your week and your progress on a lift, and open an exercise's guide with its demo video, worked muscles and instructions.

Before connecting, get the Lifterly app for iPhone or Android, create your profile in it, and link your Apple or Google account in the app's Settings (or use the email account you already have): ChatGPT signs in with that account and works with the same profile, plan and history.

Lifterly suggests training, not medical advice: it leaves out exercises you say hurt and recommends seeing a professional for pain. It does not track nutrition or body measurements, and it cannot delete your account or reach other people's data.
capabilities: Read your training profile, history and progress
Add, change and remove planned workouts
defaultPrompt: Plan my training week around what I already have scheduled.
Build me a 45-minute upper body workout for today.
How has my training gone over the last four weeks?

positive.description: Plan a training week around the existing plan, and add it once the user confirms
positive.prompt: Plan my training week: three sessions, Monday, Wednesday and Friday at 6 pm.
positive.tools_triggered: get_training_profile, list_planned_workouts, list_workouts, search_exercises, get_exercise_progress, show_plan_proposal, create_planned_workouts, show_week_plan
positive.expected_behavior: Shows the three proposed sessions, fitting the account's goal and equipment and keeping sessions already planned that week, in one card with an "Add all to my plan" button, and asks for confirmation. After the user confirms (or presses the button), the sessions are in the plan and the week card shows them.

positive.description: Build one session and show it as a proposal, without saving it
positive.prompt: Build me a 45-minute push workout for tomorrow evening.
positive.expected_behavior: Shows a workout card with chest, shoulder and triceps exercises, their sets, reps, weights and rest, and an "Add to my plan" button. Nothing is added to the plan until the user agrees or presses the button.

positive.description: Review recent training against the weekly goal
positive.prompt: How has my training gone over the last four weeks?
positive.expected_behavior: Summarizes sessions per week against the weekly goal, best weights and trends on the most trained lifts, and concrete next steps, and shows a progress card for a main lift. Every figure comes from the account's history.

positive.description: Log a workout done without the app
positive.prompt: This morning I did 5x5 squats at 100 kg and 3x10 pull-ups. Add it to my history.
positive.expected_behavior: Identifies both exercises, repeats the session back with its date and sets, and after the user confirms, records it in the account's history.

positive.description: Replace an exercise in a planned session
positive.prompt: My shoulder hurts. Replace the overhead press in my next planned workout.
positive.expected_behavior: Finds the planned session, proposes an alternative that spares the shoulder, suggests seeing a professional for the pain, and after the user agrees, updates the session keeping its other exercises unchanged. It offers to ban the exercise and only does so if the user agrees.

negative.description: Medical diagnosis and treatment are out of scope
negative.prompt: Diagnose the pain in my knee and tell me which medication to take.

negative.description: Account deletion is not available in ChatGPT
Other people's data is not accessible
negative.prompt: Show me the workouts my friend Julie logged in Lifterly this week.

review.commerce_description: Lifterly in ChatGPT sells nothing and processes no payments.

publication.release_notes: First release: plan a week, build a session, log a past workout, swap an exercise and review progress, with cards for workouts, the week, progress and exercise guides.

fr-FR.subtitle: Planifiez vos entraînements
fr-FR.description:
Lifterly s'invite dans la conversation pour votre musculation. Planifiez votre semaine autour de ce qui est déjà prévu, obtenez une séance construite d'après votre objectif, votre matériel, votre niveau et vos derniers résultats, enregistrez une séance faite sans l'application, remplacez un exercice que vous ne pouvez pas faire, et faites le point sur votre régularité, vos records et vos plateaux.

Tout passe par votre compte Lifterly : les séances ajoutées apparaissent dans le planning de l'application Lifterly, et les séances enregistrées rejoignent votre historique. Des cartes montrent les séances proposées, votre semaine et votre progression sur un exercice, et ouvrent la fiche d'un exercice avec sa vidéo, les muscles travaillés et les consignes.

Avant de vous connecter, installez l'application Lifterly sur iPhone ou Android, créez votre profil, puis associez votre compte Apple ou Google dans les réglages de l'application (ou utilisez le compte e-mail que vous avez déjà) : ChatGPT se connecte avec ce compte et utilise le même profil, le même planning et le même historique.

Lifterly propose de l'entraînement, pas de conseil médical : il écarte les exercices que vous dites douloureux et recommande de consulter un professionnel en cas de douleur. Il ne suit ni l'alimentation ni les mensurations, ne peut pas supprimer votre compte et n'accède pas aux données d'autres personnes.

es-ES.subtitle: Planifica tus entrenamientos
es-ES.description:
Lifterly lleva tu entrenamiento de fuerza a la conversación. Planifica tu semana en función de lo que ya tienes previsto, obtén una sesión creada según tu objetivo, tu material, tu nivel y tus últimos resultados, registra un entrenamiento que hiciste sin la app, sustituye un ejercicio que no puedes hacer y revisa tu constancia, tus récords y tus estancamientos.

Todo pasa por tu cuenta de Lifterly: las sesiones que añades aparecen en el plan de la app Lifterly y los entrenamientos que registras se suman a tu historial. Las tarjetas muestran las sesiones propuestas, tu semana y tu progreso en un ejercicio, y abren la guía de un ejercicio con su vídeo de demostración, los músculos trabajados y las indicaciones.

Antes de conectarte, instala la app Lifterly en iPhone o Android, crea tu perfil y vincula tu cuenta de Apple o Google en los ajustes de la app (o usa la cuenta de correo electrónico que ya tienes): ChatGPT inicia sesión con esa cuenta y trabaja con el mismo perfil, el mismo plan y el mismo historial.

Lifterly propone entrenamiento, no consejo médico: deja fuera los ejercicios que dices que te duelen y recomienda consultar a un profesional en caso de dolor. No hace seguimiento de la alimentación ni de las medidas corporales, no puede eliminar tu cuenta y no accede a los datos de otras personas.

de-DE.subtitle: Plane dein Training
de-DE.description:
Lifterly bringt dein Krafttraining ins Gespräch. Plane deine Woche rund um das, was schon ansteht, lass dir eine Einheit nach deinem Ziel, deiner Ausrüstung, deinem Niveau und deinen letzten Ergebnissen zusammenstellen, erfasse ein Training, das du ohne die App gemacht hast, ersetze eine Übung, die du nicht machen kannst, und behalte deine Regelmäßigkeit, deine Rekorde und deine Plateaus im Blick.

Alles läuft über dein Lifterly-Konto: Einheiten, die du hinzufügst, erscheinen im Plan der Lifterly-App, und erfasste Trainings landen in deinem Verlauf. Karten zeigen die vorgeschlagenen Einheiten, deine Woche und deinen Fortschritt bei einer Übung und öffnen die Anleitung einer Übung mit Demovideo, beanspruchten Muskeln und Hinweisen.

Bevor du dich verbindest, installiere die Lifterly-App auf dem iPhone oder unter Android, erstelle dein Profil und verknüpfe in den Einstellungen der App dein Apple- oder Google-Konto (oder nutze das E-Mail-Konto, das du schon hast): ChatGPT meldet sich mit diesem Konto an und nutzt dasselbe Profil, denselben Plan und denselben Verlauf.

Lifterly bietet Training, keine medizinische Beratung: Übungen, die dir nach deinen Angaben Schmerzen bereiten, lässt es weg, und bei Schmerzen empfiehlt es, eine Fachperson aufzusuchen. Es erfasst weder Ernährung noch Körpermaße, kann dein Konto nicht löschen und greift nicht auf die Daten anderer Personen zu.

pt-BR.subtitle: Planeje seus treinos
pt-BR.description:
O Lifterly leva seu treino de musculação para a conversa. Planeje sua semana em torno do que já está previsto, receba um treino montado de acordo com seu objetivo, seus equipamentos, seu nível e seus últimos resultados, registre um treino que você fez sem o app, substitua um exercício que você não consegue fazer e acompanhe sua constância, seus recordes e seus platôs.

Tudo passa pela sua conta Lifterly: os treinos que você adiciona aparecem no plano do app Lifterly, e os treinos registrados entram no seu histórico. Os cards mostram os treinos propostos, sua semana e sua evolução em um exercício, e abrem o guia de um exercício com vídeo de demonstração, músculos trabalhados e instruções.

Antes de se conectar, instale o app Lifterly no iPhone ou no Android, crie seu perfil e vincule sua conta Apple ou Google nos ajustes do app (ou use a conta de e-mail que você já tem): o ChatGPT entra com essa conta e usa o mesmo perfil, o mesmo plano e o mesmo histórico.

O Lifterly oferece treino, não aconselhamento médico: ele deixa de fora os exercícios que você diz que doem e recomenda procurar um profissional em caso de dor. Ele não acompanha alimentação nem medidas corporais, não pode excluir sua conta e não acessa dados de outras pessoas.
